messages:
riley: Heads up— release pipeline blocked by a regen diff on branch feature/regen-doc-filter. CI flags it as an API change but the diff looks like docs-only reordering and a tiny README example tweak.

samir: Yikes. Can you paste the snippet?

regen-bot: pipeline: typegen job #5340 failed (exit 1). Artifact: /artifacts/typegen/2987654321/regendiff.out

riley: Snippet: ```diff
-  - changelog: ["setup", "migration"]
+  - changelog: ["migration", "setup"]
```

zoe: Also saw README auth block changed in generated python vs node: `default_retry: 3` -> `2`. That flips a sampleapp smoke occasionally.

pat: Our semver guard currently treats any regen mismatch as a potential surface change. We should be smarter: detect docs-only diffs (changelogs, README examples, docs/*) and surface a WARN instead of FAIL.

samir: Agreed. Suggestion: implement a small classifier that walks the regendiff and marks it docs-only if changed paths match a whitelist and no schema/contracts changed. Emit WARN in release UI and let release approver override.

riley: Short-term we can unblock the release with a manual override once the WARN is surfaced. Long-term we need to fix generator nondeterminism.

zoe: I'll add a cheap DX parity check: regex-compare the "retry" number in generated SDK README auth examples across languages; if mismatched, fail a DX check (not the release gate) and post into #devex for triage. That will surface flaky sampleapp behavior.

pat: Also propose a minimal idempotence CI step gated to PRs touching /openapi or /generator: `./scripts/regen && ./scripts/regen && git status --porcelain`. Fail CI if dirty. Keeps minutes low while catching most flips.

samir: I'll open a generator PR to canonicalize $ref traversal and normalize array output for changelog metadata. Add a unit test that runs regen twice on an anyOf-heavy fixture.

riley: Filing INC ticket to unstick the current release and track follow-ups: https://redwood-internal/ops/INC-2078-regen-doc-classify. I'll manually approve this publish once the semver->WARN patch lands.

zoe: Great. I'll add the regex parity check to sampleapp CI and make it non-blocking for release but blocking for DX-only merges.

pat: Thanks all. Smaller follow-up: log the exact regendiff classifier output in the release UI so reviewers see why it was downgraded to WARN. Helps audits.

samir: Will do. Planning to land the generator determinism patch and the idempotence CI job today.

riley: Awesome. Closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
